snippet.title: Spanky's Bat-A-Swing | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Spanky's Battle Swing is a 3D rhythm based platformer, inspired by 1930s cartoons and electro swing music! Enter and explore Metronopolis, where everything and everyone moves and dances on the beat of music. Help Spanky the Bat teach Mayor Metrognome a lesson!

Wishlist Spanky on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337560/
